audit_items.proof_trace: All Discord API calls in syncAllRoles go through discord.js v14 methods (member.roles.add/remove, guild.members.fetch), which route through @discordjs/rest's RateLimitManager — this transparently detects HTTP 429 responses, suspends the relevant route bucket, and retries after the retry_after interval, satisfying the 'backoff or queuing' requirement. The sequential for...of loop with await provides additional natural pacing (no concurrent burst). The triggering endpoint is admin-only (checkAdmin() at members.ts:615), eliminating external attacker reachability.
